answer: Admission auction breaks the spiral of fake identities: each epoch auctions only 200 slots, winners pay 40 coins and lock the slot 20 epochs. A crystal-clear ledger lists all bids; a quill signature ties one slot to one bidder, so duplicates fail. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 coins, far above one slot's 30-day reward of 20 coins. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards for 20 epochs.
